name: translation
meaning: Converting C source into an executable through compilation and linking.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: format conversion
meaning: A printf instruction such as %d that specifies how to interpret a matching argument.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: undefined behavior
meaning: A situation for which the C standard imposes no requirements on program behavior.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: bit mask
meaning: An integer pattern used to select or change chosen bits.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: shadowing
meaning: An inner declaration hiding an outer name within its scope.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: fallthrough
meaning: Continuing from one switch label into following statements without leaving the switch.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: sizeof
meaning: An operator giving storage size in C bytes; an array object size differs from a pointer size.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: character constant
meaning: A single-quoted C character constant; an ordinary one has type int.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: null terminator
meaning: The zero character that marks the end of a C string.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: bounded formatting
meaning: Formatting into storage with an explicit capacity and checking truncation or error.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: validated conversion
meaning: Parsing text while checking whether digits were consumed, the full input matched and the value fit.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: function prototype
meaning: A declaration specifying a C function’s return and parameter types.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: dereference
meaning: Using a valid pointer to designate the object it points to.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: C pass-by-value
meaning: Giving a function a copy of each supplied argument value, including pointer values.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: pointer arithmetic
meaning: Moving a pointer by array elements within one array.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: storage duration
meaning: The period during execution for which storage for an object is reserved.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: const-qualified access
meaning: An access path that does not permit modifying the pointed-to value.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: optional output pointer
meaning: A pointer parameter whose contract permits NULL to omit an output.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: structure member
meaning: A named component accessed with . or through a pointer with ->.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: typedef
meaning: An alternative name for an existing type, not a separate allocation.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: C enum
meaning: A type with named integer constants used here to describe explicit states.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: tagged union
meaning: A union plus a separately maintained tag identifying the stored alternative.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: malloc
meaning: A standard allocation function returning uninitialized storage or NULL.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: calloc
meaning: An array allocation function that initializes allocated storage bits to zero.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: realloc
meaning: Resizing an allocation, preserving the old contents up to the smaller size on success.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: ownership
meaning: The responsibility to release a resource; in C this must be maintained by program design.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: allocation-size guard
meaning: A check that prevents unsigned multiplication from wrapping before allocation.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: capacity
meaning: The number of allocated element slots, distinct from the initialized logical length.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: linked node
meaning: An independently stored record connected to another through a pointer.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: comparator
meaning: A function reporting ordering by a negative, zero, or positive result.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Header guard
meaning: Preprocessor conditionals that avoid repeated processing of a header in one translation unit.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Internal linkage
meaning: A name designating an entity only within its translation unit.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Macro expansion
meaning: Token substitution performed by the preprocessor, not an ordinary function call.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Conditional compilation
meaning: Including or excluding source text using preprocessing conditions.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Generic selection
meaning: Compile-time selection of an expression according to a controlling expression’s type.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Stream ownership
meaning: Responsibility for checking acquisition and closing a FILE stream exactly once.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: EOF sentinel
meaning: An int result indicating no next character, with stream indicators distinguishing end-of-file from error.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Byte order
meaning: The specified order of octets representing a multi-octet value.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: errno
meaning: A library error indicator meaningful only according to the called operation’s documented contract.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Cleanup path
meaning: A control-flow route that releases already-acquired resources before returning a status.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Regression test
meaning: A repeatable check protecting previously expected behavior against later changes.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Sanitizer
meaning: Runtime instrumentation that detects certain errors on exercised paths, without proving all paths safe.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Object file
meaning: Compiled output for a translation unit that still may need other definitions at link time.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Argument vector
meaning: The array of command-line string pointers supplied to hosted main, followed by a null pointer.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Thread join
meaning: Waiting for a thread to terminate and establishing synchronization before later observation.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Mutex
meaning: A mutual-exclusion object coordinating access to shared state.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Sequential consistency
meaning: The default atomic ordering that includes one total order of sequentially consistent atomic operations.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Volatile qualification
meaning: A qualifier affecting accesses, without providing thread synchronization or atomic read-modify-write.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Capacity invariant
meaning: A rule keeping the count of occupied entries within the allocated storage bound.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.
